Any Jew or Christian who hears of the Prophet and dies without believing in what he was sent with will be among the people of the Fire.
The Prophet calls the Jews to Islam, warning of expulsion; Banu Nadir are expelled, Quraiza's men killed after they fought, and he vows to expel Jews and Christians from Arabia.
The Prophet said Muslims would follow the ways of those before them step by step, even into a lizard's hole, and confirmed he meant the Jews and Christians.
